question: frontend mismatch: do the candidate's ASR errors concentrate on words whose phonemes differ between the fed and the other espeak voice?

method.phoneme_distance: edit distance between the two voices' phoneme sequences without stress marks, divided by the fed length
method.word_errors: substituted or deleted reference words in the JiWER alignment (scorer transform)
method.word_level_sentences: only sentences whose phoneme words align one-to-one with the reference words
method.difference_in_differences: (candidate rate on differing - same words) - (control rate on differing - same words)
method.limits: correlational; Whisper-small transcripts; one synthesis per sentence; not a causal test
